description: Use this first to convert a store URL or store domain into a tracked Clickwise affiliate link for your account. Pass url or domain, and optionally a static placement subid without personal data. Requires affiliate:links on your OAuth connection or your own Clickwise affiliate API key.

domain.description: Store domain when no full URL is provided.

subid.description: Optional static placement tag without user data, emails or phone numbers.

url.description: Store or product http/https URL to convert into a tracked link.

name: monetize_target
title: Monetize store URL or domain
